name: Hot Worlds
detailed_description:
Welcome to HOT WORLDS. The biggest Interdimensional Anything-Goes fighting tournament in the universe!

When bored athlete Valentina Rubio discovers a mysterious portal to another dimension, her world is turn upside down as she gets caught up in a fierce competition to rise through the ranks of a mysterious tournament and win the Interdimensional Superhot Champion Belt. But to get there, she'll need to jump through portals to travel through dimensions and defeat the local title holders. Only then can she win the right to challenge the interdimensional champion for the title.

But there's something weird going on with HOT WORLDS. Who even started it? Where are all these portals coming from? Why does everyone seem to have super powers? You'll just have to fight to find out!

  • Fast-paced combat

  • Fully customizable movesets

  • Nine playable characters

  • High-res hand drawn pixel art

  • Co-op and team-based PVP

  • Three game modes

Adventure

  • Follow Val's journey as she travels across dimensions fighting to become the champion of HOT WORLDS!

  • Compete in local tournaments to build rank and explore the universe along the way.

  • Learn new moves to pick your own fighting style.

  • Challenge local champions to title fights.

  • Make friends with champions and form tag-teams to compliment each other's weaknesses.

  • Lose all your hard-earned money at the casino!

Arcade:

  • Pick one of nine playable characters and fight through a gauntlet of enemies.

  • Buy upgrades and powerful aura moves along the way to get an edge in battle .

  • Four difficulty levels, enemies are smarter and have more powerful moves as you progress.

Arena

  • Fight your friends or against the computer.

  • Single battle, Double battle, Tag-team, and Free for all modes.

  • Complete special challenges.

  • Practice your custom movesets and combos in training mode.
